sourceNotes.rawContent: Effortlessly elegant, our Pearl Station Necklace features lustrous faux pearls delicately spaced along a shimmering gold-toned chain. This timeless fashion piece is designed to bring a touch of sophisticated charm to your everyday style or special occasion looks. To maintain the beautiful luster of the pearls and the radiance of the chain, we recommend treating this piece with care by avoiding contact with water, perfumes, and lotions, and storing it in a dry place after use.

notes: Stone candidate 'imitation pearl' is stated without a hedge because the source itself says "faux pearls" — the imitation nature is the source's own claim, not an inference.
